info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Trust Services Management API
info.description: The Trust Services Management API enables organizations to initiate and manage trust services for their banking consumers. This endpoint allows for the creation of new trust service requests, tailoring services to meet specific consumer needs. Typical consumers include financial institutions and service providers looking to enhance their trust services offering. With this API, businesses can streamline operations, ensuring a secure and efficient process for managing consumer trust requirements.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new trust service in the system, ensuring that all necessary details are provided for proper registration and management of the service.

requestBody.description: Detailed information regarding trust services requested by the consumer. This should include necessary data for processing the operation, such as consumer identifiers and trust service specifics.
